verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec for its Management API, which covers organizations, projects, branches and configuration. A probe confirmed the spec is live at supabase.com/openapi.json, and llms.txt points agents to it. Beyond that, every project gets auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, and features such as advisors are documented as reachable through the Management API. Missing for 10: an independent hands-on authenticated call that drives a project end-to-end through the Management API (the probe only fetched the spec, and the pack's Management API description is a single llms.txt line, so in-depth endpoint reference docs are not evidenced).
